name: PRONOUS
description: Agentic market desk for tokenized equities on BNB Smart Chain. Watches Ondo / bStocks / xStocks token-vs-reference gaps, runs deterministic preflight (BSC-only, spot-only, spend cap, data quality), requires simulation and explicit user confirmation before any spend. Signal is never permission to spend. MCP tools are read-only or preflight-only; the server does not broadcast swaps. Optional Proof of Action can be anchored on-chain (user pays BNB gas only).

services.name: MCP
services.notes: npx -y github:wadezigh96/pronous — tools: market_assets, scan_asset, preflight, ask_pronous, cmc_market_context
